This is am American reprint, possibly pirated. \'Buy a Broom\' has not been identified, but \'Kaspar\'s Summer Dream\' MP (Christmas 1876) 16-32, and \'Early Dew, or, the Boy Bishop\' MP (Christmas 1878), 6-20, were certainly by CMY.
